name: ip2region
description: Ip2region is an offline IP-to-Region localization library and IP data management framework with both IPv4 and IPv6 supports, 10-microsecond level query efficiency, xdb search client for many programming languages

latest_release.name: v3.19.0
latest_release.body:
## New Features
* IPv4 source and binary data updates with community reports merge.
* Type Annotations and UV package manager for Python binding, Pypi version `3.0.6`.
* CI test for all binding and maker.
* Logstash filter plugin binding.
* fix the Possible heap-buffer-overflow due to corrupted .xdb file.

## What's Changed
* merge fix reported by community by @lionsoul2014 in https://github.com/lionsoul2014/ip2region/pull/528
* merge fixed reported by issue 529 by @lionsoul2014 in https://github.com/lionsoul2014/ip2region/pull/530
* ✨ Python type annotations by @sunkunxi in https://github.com/lionsoul2014/ip2region/pull/532
* 🧑‍💻  UV package manager by @sunkunxi in https://github.com/lionsoul2014/ip2region/pull/533
* ci: test every binding and maker on Linux, macOS and Windows runners by @Alice39s in https://github.com/lionsoul2014/ip2region/pull/539
* feat(logstash): add an ip2region filter plugin by @Alice39s in https://github.com/lionsoul2014/ip2region/pull/540
* merge fix report on issue/542 by @lionsoul2014 in https://github.com/lionsoul2014/ip2region/pull/543
* chore(deps-dev): update uv-build requirement from <0.12.0,>=0.11.0 to >=0.11.0,<0.14.0 in /scripts/ci in the control-plane group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/lionsoul2014/ip2region/pull/541
* Fix c binding heap buffer overflow by @lionsoul2014 in https://github.com/lionsoul2014/ip2region/pull/546

## New Contributors
* @sunkunxi made their first contribution in https://github.com/lionsoul2014/ip2region/pull/532

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lionsoul2014/ip2region/compare/v3.18.0...v3.19.0
